1. Buying = Triggered Journey (Not Instant)

🔴 1. PAIN (Sab yahin se start hota hai)

Insaan tab tak nahi kharidega jab tak usko pain feel nahi hota.

👉 Types of pain:

Time waste ho raha hai
Paisa loss ho raha hai
Growth slow hai
Stress hai

👉 Example (tere client):
“Team kaam kar rahi hai but output slow hai”

👉 Insight:
No pain = no purchase

👀 2. AWARENESS (Problem ko naam milta hai)

Ab banda samajhta hai:
👉 “haan problem hai”

👉 But abhi tak solution nahi pata

👉 Trigger:

Content (LinkedIn, YouTube)
Kisi aur ka experience
Comparison

👉 Yeh stage me tu usko educate karta hai

🔍 3. INTEREST (Solution ki taraf shift)

Ab banda search karega:

“how to automate business”
“best tools for workflow”

👉 Yeh curiosity stage hai

👉 Insight:
Yaha attention capture karna hota hai

🧠 4. TRUST (Game yahin jeeta ya haara jata hai)

Ab banda decide nahi karta instantly
👉 Wo check karta hai:

Kya yeh banda expert hai?
Kya isne results diye hain?
Kya dusre log use kar rahe hain?

👉 Trust build hota hai:

Case studies
Testimonials
Content consistency

👉 Reality:
Log product nahi, trust kharidte hain

⚖️ 5. JUSTIFICATION (Logic ka illusion)

Ab banda internally justify karta hai:

“Yeh investment worth hai”
“Mujhe ROI milega”
“Yeh mere problem solve karega”

👉 Yeh sab logic hai
👉 But decision already emotional ho chuka hota hai

💥 6. ACTION (Final trigger)

Final push kya hota hai?

👉 Triggers:

Urgency (limited offer)
Fear of missing out (FOMO)
Clear CTA
Risk reversal (free trial)

👉 Example:
“Book free audit → see results in 7 days”
🧬 3. Core Psychological Drivers (Real game yahan hai)

🧲 1. PAIN > PLEASURE

Insaan:
👉 Pain avoid karne ke liye zyada fast act karta hai
👉 Pleasure ke liye slow

👉 Example:
“Save time” < “Stop wasting 5 hours daily”

👥 2. SOCIAL PROOF

“Dusre log kar rahe hain → safe hai”
